notes: Single source for console guide anchors and tours. Read by App\Services\Assistant\GuideRegistry (tool validation and prompt) and injected per role into the page for public/js/assistant/guide-engine.js. Every anchor id must appear as data-guide="id" in resources/views. UI copy rule: plain short English, no em dashes, en dashes or middots.

shell.nav.label: Sidebar
shell.nav.description: The console menu. Every page is listed here, port operations first and then management.

shell.menu.label: Menu button
shell.menu.description: Opens or collapses the sidebar. On a small screen it opens the page menu.

shell.advisories.label: Advisories shortcut
shell.advisories.description: The bell opens Travel Advisory, where you prepare and publish passenger notices.

shell.theme.label: Light or dark switch
shell.theme.description: Switches the console between light and dark.

shell.account.label: Your profile
shell.account.description: Your initial. Opens your profile with your account details.

account.tour.label: Take the tour
account.tour.description: Starts the guided tour of the console. It works without the AI connection.

account.signout.label: Logout
account.signout.description: Signs you out of the console on this device.

assistant.launcher.label: Assistant
assistant.launcher.description: Opens this assistant. Ask a question or ask it to show you a part of the console.

nav.dashboard.label: Dashboard link
nav.dashboard.description: Opens the port overview with things to do, departures and recent bookings.

nav.fleet.label: Fleet Management link
nav.fleet.description: Opens the vessel list with capacity and availability.

nav.trips.label: Trip and Schedule link
nav.trips.description: Opens departures, recurring rules, seat maps and manifests.

nav.tickets.label: Ticketing and Booking link
nav.tickets.description: Opens bookings, discount ID checks, the counter and refund requests.

nav.advisories.label: Travel Advisory link
nav.advisories.description: Opens passenger notices with drafts, published alerts and sending status.

nav.sms.label: SMS delivery link
nav.sms.description: Opens the SMS connection and message activity.

nav.fares.label: Fare Management link
nav.fares.description: Opens the route fare matrix used at checkout.

nav.reports.label: Reports and Audit link
nav.reports.description: Opens sales, passenger counts and the audit log.

nav.users.label: User Management menu
nav.users.description: Opens the passenger list and scanner staff accounts.

dash.counter.label: Open booking counter
dash.counter.description: Goes to Ticketing and Booking to help a walk-in passenger book.

dash.attention.label: Things to do
dash.attention.description: Start here for booking checks, departure preparation and passenger updates. Each row opens the screen where that work happens.

dash.departures.label: Upcoming departures
dash.departures.description: The next sailings in departure order with time, vessel and a manifest download.

dash.manifest.label: Manifest download
dash.manifest.description: Downloads the confirmed passenger list for that trip as a CSV file.

dash.bookings.label: Recent bookings
dash.bookings.description: The latest passenger and counter bookings. Pending payment and ID review are different states.

dash.today.label: Today at the port
dash.today.description: Collected today, departures today, active vessels and bookings awaiting payment. Collected amounts are booking records, not a bank settlement.

dash.fleet.label: Your fleet
dash.fleet.description: Each vessel with its capacity. The dot shows whether it is active.

fleet.add.label: Add Boat
fleet.add.description: Opens the form for a new vessel with its name, capacity and availability. Opening it saves nothing.

fleet.list.label: Vessels
fleet.list.description: Each vessel with its capacity, registry details and status.

fleet.status.label: Vessel status
fleet.status.description: Sets a vessel to Active, Under Maintenance or Out of Service. Resolve upcoming bookings before taking a vessel out of service.

trips.add.label: Add Schedule
trips.add.description: Opens the schedule form. Choose an active vessel, route, date and time slot for one departure or a recurring rule.

trips.tabs.label: Trip tabs
trips.tabs.description: Switch between scheduled, active and recently completed trips, and recurring rules.

trips.recurring.label: Recurring Rules
trips.recurring.description: Rules that generate individual departures on the days you choose.

trips.list.label: Scheduled trips
trips.list.description: Upcoming departures with times, vessel and seats left.

trips.seats.label: Seats
trips.seats.description: Opens the seat map for a departure to see which seats are taken.

trips.manifest.label: Passenger manifest
trips.manifest.description: Downloads the confirmed passenger list for that departure as a CSV file.

tickets.date.label: Trip date filter
tickets.date.description: Choose a trip date to list its bookings.

tickets.tabs.label: Booking tabs
tickets.tabs.description: Switch between pending, confirmed and cancelled bookings. Only confirmed tickets can board.

tickets.pending.label: Pending bookings
tickets.pending.description: Unpaid reservations, late payment reviews and paid discounted tickets waiting for an ID check.

tickets.details.label: Passenger details
tickets.details.description: Opens the passengers on a booking with their fare type and the uploaded discount ID photo.

tickets.approve.label: Approve
tickets.approve.description: Approves a student, senior or PWD ID after you check the photo, then issues the boarding pass.

tickets.counter.label: Counter booking
tickets.counter.description: Book seats for a walk-in passenger. Choose the departure and fare categories, then check the amount and seats.

tickets.refunds.label: Refund requests
tickets.refunds.description: Cancellation and refund requests from passengers. Refunds go through PayMongo, not the assistant.

adv.form.label: Create Advisory
adv.form.description: Enter the type, affected route, severity and clear instructions for passengers.

adv.draft.label: Save as Draft
adv.draft.description: Keeps the advisory out of the passenger feed until you publish it.

adv.publish.label: Publish Advisory
adv.publish.description: Publishes the advisory to passengers. Email and SMS go out only when that box is ticked and sending is configured.

adv.list.label: Manage Alerts
adv.list.description: Drafts, published and archived advisories with their sending status. A queued SMS does not prove a passenger received it.

fares.matrix.label: Fare matrix
fares.matrix.description: Regular, student and senior fares for each route and direction. Checkout calculates the fare on the server.

fares.save.label: Save All Fares
fares.save.description: Saves every changed fare in the matrix. Nothing changes until you save.

reports.filters.label: Report filters
reports.filters.description: Set the date or period before reading or exporting totals.

reports.export.label: Export CSV
reports.export.description: Downloads the filtered sales transactions as a CSV file.

reports.sales.label: Sales report
reports.sales.description: Recorded collections and refunds for the chosen period.

reports.passengers.label: Passenger count report
reports.passengers.description: Passengers carried against each vessel's capacity.

reports.audit.label: Audit log
reports.audit.description: Recorded actions such as schedule, fare and booking changes.

sms.connection.label: SMS connection
sms.connection.description: Shows whether TextLink sending is configured. Not configured means SeaPass cannot send SMS yet.

sms.log.label: Message activity
sms.log.description: Queued, accepted, failed or unknown messages. Check TextLink before retrying an uncertain message.

users.search.label: Passenger search
users.search.description: Find a passenger account by name or email.

users.staffAdd.label: Add scanner staff
users.staffAdd.description: Opens the form for a new scanner staff account. Opening it saves nothing.

users.staff.label: Scanner staff accounts
users.staff.description: Scanner staff accounts and whether each one is active.

profile.details.label: Profile details
profile.details.description: Your name, email, role and how long you have used SeaPass.

steps.body: Use the sidebar to move between port work. Port operations come first, then management.
Start each day here. Each row opens the screen where that work happens.
Check the next sailings and download a passenger manifest for a departure.
See today's collections, departures and active vessels at a glance.
Add Schedule opens the form for a new departure or a recurring rule. This tour does not open it.
Scheduled departures show seats left, the seat map and the manifest.
Bookings are split into pending, confirmed and cancelled. Only confirmed tickets can board.
Use the counter to book seats for walk-in passengers.
Prepare weather, route or sailing notices here. Save a draft or publish it.
Set the route fares and discount rates used at checkout.
Choose a period, then read or export sales and passenger counts.
Take this tour again from here at any time.
Ask the assistant a question or ask it to show you a part of the console.
Add Schedule opens the form. Choose an active vessel, the route, the date and a time slot, then check the seats. This tour does not open or save it.
For a regular sailing, choose a recurring rule in the form instead. Rules create each departure for you.
New departures appear under Scheduled Trips.
Check the departure time, vessel and seats left.
Open the seat map to see which seats are taken.
Download the confirmed passenger manifest before boarding.
Choose the trip date to list its bookings.
Paid discounted tickets waiting for an ID check are under Pending.
Look for bookings marked ID Verification.
Open the passengers to see each fare type and the uploaded ID photo. Check the name and the ID type.
Approve only when the ID matches. Approval issues the boarding pass. This tour approves nothing.
If the ID does not qualify, Reject and Refund starts a PayMongo refund. Follow it here.
Choose the advisory type, the affected route and the severity, then write clear instructions.
Save as Draft keeps it out of the passenger feed while you review it.
Publish puts it in the passenger feed. Email and SMS go out only when that box is ticked and sending is configured.
Check its status here. A queued SMS does not prove a passenger received it.
Check SMS delivery for failed or uncertain messages before you retry.
